title: rpt config record
description: The report config, rpt.yaml, as in effect: an absent severities, required_sections or sections key gives the defaults. Plugin sections (x-<plugin>) appear as extra members; other keys rpt doesn't define are left out. rpt config get <path> gives only that member (with kind and rev). Schema version 2.

severities.description: The report's severity levels, most severe first.

sections.description: Each fixed section's key (description, remediation, poc) and the heading this report gives it.

required_sections.description: The sections every finding must have and fill in: a fixed section's key, or a custom section's heading.

rules.description: Rule name to the level its problems take, overriding the rule's own; absent rules keep theirs.

pages.description: The order of the pages: page IDs, and findings where the findings go. Pages it doesn't list come last, by ID.

required_pages.description: Page IDs that must exist with a non-empty body.

rev.description: rpt.yaml's revision. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the config changed since this read.

lines.description: Where each top-level key sits in rpt.yaml. Given by rpt config get --lines.

file.description: Absolute path of rpt.yaml, in the form rpt opened the report by, symlinks not resolved.

^x-.description: A plugin's settings, kept and edited by rpt, never read by it.
